Retracted-claim registry: a claim listed here was factually incorrect and is retracted org-wide (per the one-product-truth programme), but frozen Docusaurus version snapshots are never rewritten -- see docs/src/development/content-ownership.md in agent-assembly for the ownership model this obeys. `pattern` is matched literally (not a regex) against each page's raw Markdown source, case-sensitive, by scripts/generate-retraction-map.mjs, which finds every (version, page) pair containing it and writes website/src/generated/retraction-map.ts. retractionBanner.ts (a Docusaurus clientModule) reads that generated map at runtime and renders `notice` + a link to `canonical` on any matching page, on every kind of page load (direct URL, search result, or version-picker navigation), without touching the frozen page's own committed content. A retraction here does not, by itself, prove coverage -- the generated map only knows about a page if this file names the exact substring; adding a phrase to CI (see check_claim_vocabulary in the docs repo) does not retroactively register history the way this file does.
